violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety that is registered with the RIDOH Center for Food Protection. Application printed for the PIC. Per the Manager, application to be submitted within 24 hrs. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

The drainpipe to the prep sink was observed to be detached/disconnected from the sink drain (drainpipe observed on the floor). Plumbing system is to be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety that is registered with the RIDOH Center for Food Protection. Application printed for the PIC at the time of inspection and to be submitted by end of day Friday 7-31-26 New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

Chicken tenders were observed held at 100-120 degrees Fahrenheit in the hot hold unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food items were voluntarily disposed of by the PIC at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

Several food items in the Open-Air Cooler #1 were observed held at 47-54 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food items were voluntarily disposed of by the PIC at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

The following equipment was observed in need of repair/adjustment: - Open-Air Cooler #1 was observed holding an ambient temperature of 48 degrees Fahrenheit with food items observed at 47-54 degrees Fahrenheit. Use of unit for storage of Time/Temperature Control for Safety (TCS) Foods is to be discontinued until serviced/repaired. Call made for service at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

The drainpipe to the prep sink was observed to be detached/disconnected from the sink drain (drainpipe observed on the floor). Plumbing system is to be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety that is registered with the RIDOH Center for Food Protection. CFSM License Application was printed at the time of inspection. Application is to be submitted as soon as possible. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025

3 Individual Pizzas were observed held at 46 degrees Fahrenheit in the reach-in cooler. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Pizzas were voluntarily disposed of by the PIC at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025

Several items (deli sandwiches/wraps) prepared same day were observed held in refrigeration for customer selection in closed plastic clamshell containers at 46 to 47degrees Fahrenheit. Prepared food items are to be cooled properly to 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below before being enclosed in the plastic containers and set for customer selection. Food items were moved to the walk-in refrigerator and opened for rapid cooling at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025

The walls in the 3 bay sink area were observed to have an accumulation of soil residue and debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2025

Several Calzones in the Small Open Air Cooler were observed held at 42 to 46 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Calzones observed at 42 to 44 degrees Fahrenheit were moved to colder zone of refrigeration (away from the shelf edge), and calzones observed at 45 to 46 degrees Fahrenheit were voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. PIC to monitor food temperatures in unit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2024
